events.text: A grand exposition of mechanical inventions opens in a European capital.

pages.title: Exhibition
pages.extract: An exhibition is an organized presentation and display of a selection of items.

events.text: A celebrated aviator completes the first nonstop crossing of a vast desert.

pages.title: Aviator
pages.extract: An aviator is a person who flies an aircraft.

events.text: A moonlit comet is photographed in remarkable detail by an observatory.

pages.title: Comet
pages.extract: A comet is an icy, small Solar System body that warms and begins to release gases when passing close to the Sun.
